findings.title: Load fallback locales for translations outside controller requests
findings.body: Fallback locales are only preloaded by ApplicationController#set_locale. The translation wrapper still loads only config.locale, and the patched backend disables automatic loading. In a background worker or mailer that has not processed a controller request, translating a missing key in a non-English locale therefore cannot find the site-locale or English translation unless those locales happen to have been loaded previously. Load the fallback chain in the translation path, rather than relying on a controller callback, so server-side fallbacks also work for jobs and mail.

findings.title: Include the site fallback locale in translation cache identity
findings.body: The fallback result now depends on SiteSetting.default_locale, but the accelerator caches no-argument translations using only the key, current locale, and backend object ID. If a key is missing in the user's locale, its site-language fallback is cached and remains in use after the administrator changes the site's default locale. Include the fallback configuration in the cache key or invalidate the cache when it changes; otherwise users continue receiving translations from the old fallback language.
